Get each school's attendance-zone status

Source: R/zones.R
gcd_school_zone_status.Rd

Whether each school of the standard districts has an attendance zone on the platform and, if not, why: a magnet or charter school with no zone, a district whose maps are not published yet, and so on. Answers "why doesn't this school have a zone?" without inferring it from a missing polygon.

Usage

gcd_school_zone_status(
  district_code = NULL,
  school_code = NULL,
  district = NULL,
  school = NULL,
  zone_status = NULL,
  no_zone_category = NULL
)

Arguments

district_code, school_code

Character vectors of codes. Default NULL.

district, school

Names, matched to codes as in gcd_rows(). A school name found in more than one district needs district too. Default NULL.

zone_status

"zoned", "no_zone" and/or "not_yet_collected". Default NULL: all.

no_zone_category

Why a school has no zone (the API's categories, listed by gcd_describe() with "school_attendance_zones"). Default NULL: all.

Value

A tibble, one row per school, with columns year (integer), district_code, district_name, school_code, school_name, zone_status, zone_levels (the levels it is zoned for, as one string), no_zone_category and reason. The API's note on reading the table is the note attribute.

See also

gcd_school_zones() for the zones; gcd_school_zone_coverage() for each district's coverage.

Other geography: gcd_district_boundaries(), gcd_locate(), gcd_school_zone_coverage(), gcd_school_zones()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
gcd_school_zone_status(district = "Atlanta Public Schools")
gcd_school_zone_status(zone_status = "no_zone")
}
